package.name: sentil
package.description: Runtime verification and controller synthesis for Apollo Cyber RT. A monitor component watches the perception, localization, and chassis channels against Signal Temporal Logic and probabilistic STL specifications and publishes a verdict; a control component synthesizes or shields a command against the same specification. Built on the SENTIL engine, which ships inside the module.
